title: Wisdom of Solomon
subtitle: a Greek-speaking Jew, in Solomon's voice, on justice, wisdom and the God who rescued Israel from Egypt
lead: The Wisdom of Solomon is a Jewish book written in Greek, most likely in Alexandria in Egypt, in the last centuries before Jesus or in his lifetime. It speaks to the rulers of the earth, praises wisdom in the voice of King Solomon, and retells the Exodus as a contrast between Egypt and Israel.
facts: The Catholic Church and the Orthodox churches; among the Apocrypha for Anglicans and Lutherans; not Scripture for most other Protestants or for Judaism.
Unknown; the book speaks in Solomon's voice in chapters 7 to 9.

audience.to: Greek-speaking Jews, most likely in Alexandria, Egypt.
audience.why: To hold them to the God of Israel and his wisdom in a Greek city full of other gods.
